description: This file contains utility functions for URL pattern matching, including glob to regex conversion, URL pattern serialization/deserialization, and URL matching logic, used within the Playwright project.

methods.name: globToRegexPattern
methods.description: Converts a glob pattern string into a regex pattern string.

methods.name: serializeURLPattern
methods.description: Serializes a URLPattern object into a plain object.

methods.name: serializeURLMatch
methods.description: Serializes a URLMatch (string, RegExp, URLPattern, or function) into a serializable object.

methods.name: deserializeURLMatch
methods.description: Deserializes a serialized URLMatch back into its original form.

methods.name: urlMatchesEqual
methods.description: Checks if two URLMatch objects are equivalent.

methods.name: urlMatches
methods.description: Determines if a URL matches a given pattern or string.

methods.name: resolveGlobToRegexPattern
methods.description: Resolves a glob pattern to a regex pattern, considering base URL and WebSocket URLs.

methods.name: constructURLBasedOnBaseURL
methods.description: Constructs a full URL based on a base URL and a given URL string.
